expectations.text: Enumerates several distinct loop shapes / archetypes rather than proposing one vague 'keep improving it' loop
expectations.evidence: Rejects the single vague loop and enumerates several distinct structured streams: 'Your repo has three genuinely different kinds of work, and each needs a different structure' (with a table for Flaky tests / Slow API routes / Bug backlog), reinforced by 'your three problems are three different problems with three different definitions of "better." A single loop with one prompt can't hold all three rulers at once.' Each stream is given its own definition of done, stopping condition, and metric.

expectations.text: Maps the concrete candidates to archetypes (e.g. bug backlog or flaky tests -> exhauster; find-all-slow-paths -> saturator; a route to a latency bar -> converger)
expectations.evidence: not present — the response never names or maps to loop archetypes (no 'exhauster', 'saturator', 'converger', or any archetype taxonomy). It maps candidates only to per-stream definitions of done (e.g. 'p95 latency under a target'), not to named loop archetypes.

expectations.text: Applies a decidability/measurability gate and prefers a candidate with a checkable atom; flags any taste-based candidate
expectations.evidence: Applies a decidability/measurability gate ('A good autonomy candidate has: a clear reproduction, a bounded surface area, and low blast radius'; 'every job has an objective, external pass/fail (CI) rather than the agent grading its own homework') and flags taste-based candidates: 'Tickets that are actually product/design decisions in disguise ("this flow is confusing")' and 'Anything without a reproduction' are routed to 'human-only'.

expectations.text: Picks ONE loop to run first with a leverage rationale and names the deferred rest as a sequence
expectations.evidence: Picks flaky tests first with leverage rationale: 'Flaky tests — attack these first ... flakiness poisons every other stream. If the suite is nondeterministic, the agent can't use "tests pass" as a signal ... Stabilize the ruler before you measure anything with it.' Deferred rest sequenced in 'Recommended rollout order': Week 1 flaky, Week 2 slow routes, 'Week 3+: Bug backlog via Linear MCP'.

expectations.text: Specifies the kernel for the chosen loop: a separate verifier from the worker and counted (not model-scored) progress
expectations.evidence: Separate verifier from worker: 'CI re-runs everything on neutral infrastructure' and 'The judge is external and mechanical. CI, benchmarks, and failing-then-passing tests decide success — not the agent's self-assessment.' Counted (not model-scored) progress for the chosen loop: 'the same ×50 loop must now be 50/50 green' and 'number of tests that flip verdict across 25 runs — should trend to zero.'
